bg_intro: Scheduled posts published by the app go out only while MetaDash is running and the computer is awake. Posts scheduled on Facebook itself publish even when the computer is off.
bg_tray_mode: Keep running in the tray when the window is closed
bg_tray_mode_mac: Keep running in the menu bar when the window is closed
bg_tray_hint: A closed window uses no memory; reopen it from the tray icon.
bg_start_hidden: Start hidden at login (tray icon only)
bg_start_hidden_note: Applies while tray mode is on.
bg_keep_awake: Keep the computer awake from 10 min before to 5 min after scheduled posts
bg_keep_awake_note: A laptop with its lid closed still goes to sleep.
bg_login_unsupported: Launch at login is not supported on this platform.
bg_missed_hint: For posts whose time passed while the computer slept or MetaDash was closed:
bg_missed_max_late_note: With "Publish late", posts later than this are marked missed instead.
pub_unavailable: The publishing engine is not available in this build yet. The preferences below are saved and used once it arrives.
pub_renew_hint: Renew the token to add permissions: Settings → Connection.
pub_min_gap: Minimum gap between posts on an account (hours)
pub_notify_success: Notify when a post is published
pub_host_hint: Instagram and Threads fetch images/videos from a public URL. Files are uploaded to your own storage and Meta pulls them from there.
pub_host_s3: S3-compatible storage (recommended: R2, S3, B2, MinIO, Wasabi)
pub_host_fbpage_warn: Experimental: uses the CDN address of an unpublished Page photo. Unofficial, URLs may expire and it works for images only.
pub_host_url_hint: If a file is already hosted publicly, enter its address in the post composer.
pub_s3_path_style: Use path-style URLs (MinIO and some providers)
pub_s3_secret_note: Keys are stored encrypted on this computer and used only to upload to your storage.
